ValidationRule.description: The Contact of Partner SE Leading is required when the POC is being led by a partner.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: (RecordType.DeveloperName = "Standard" || RecordType.DeveloperName = "TaaS") && ISPICKVAL(POC_Led_By__c, "Partner") && ISBLANK(Contact_of_Partner_SE_Leading__c) && (isNew() || DATEVALUE( CreatedDate ) > DATEVALUE("2023-08-10"))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please specify Contact of Partner SE Leading
